semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor automation equipment and related technical services, focusing on mid- and back-end processes.
summary: Shenzhen iN-Cube Automation Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise that develops and manufactures automation equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their solutions enhance production efficiency and product yield through semi-automation and full automation of processes such as wafer/chip sorting, AOI, and die bonding.
capabilities: Sorting equipment for semiconductor mid- and back-end processes

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shenzhen and has been recognized for its contributions to the high-end equipment manufacturing industry within the region.
